title: 2000 Election Report, official results of the 2000-11-07 general election

pages.hint: One boxed table for a single South Carolina legislative district: candidate names stacked over two or three lines in the header (first names above surnames, a party letter below, a WINNER marker above), county names down the left, and a STATE TOTAL row. Merge each candidate's stacked name into one label. Ignore the WINNER marker and any other district's table visible in the crop.

authoritative: The state's own printed district total and the county rows tie, and they differ from the earlier default set, which is replaced by this one.
